title: DesignSystemComponent:OntologyGraphExplorer

_meta.purpose: Typed entity/link/action graph explorer for schema admins, vertical specialists, and developers inspecting semantic, kinetic, and dynamic layers.

purpose: Typed entity/link/action graph explorer for schema admins, vertical specialists, and developers inspecting semantic, kinetic, and dynamic layers.

accessibility.keyboard: graph has tree/table mirror with node search, edge traversal, and action preview without pointer input
accessibility.screen_reader: announces node type, edge cardinality, policy tier, freshness, and hidden-field redaction

security_invariants: tier-classified properties are redacted before render unless Cedar permits
cross-tenant edges show explicit policy basis or remain hidden
dynamic-state freshness lag is visible and blocks stale decision-grade actions
